name: turn-flow-legacy-projection-closeout
title: Retire live turn-flow legacy back-projection
description: Stop mutating canonical assistant turnFlow back into legacy chat message fields across the live frontend chat runtime.
creator: yudi
notes: 2026-04-21 full-repo audit confirmed that the frontend chat runtime still calls `reconcileTurnFlowWithLegacy()` and `applyLegacyFieldsFromTurnFlow()` through live SSE, lifecycle, and finalize paths, repopulating canonical `turnFlow` into legacy `thinkingContent`, `optimizingTools`, `ragSources`, and `toolCalls`. That behavior originated as a 2026-04-16 compatibility bridge, but it now conflicts with the codex-aligned goal that chat runtime keep one unified event protocol and one canonical assistant-process read model. This needs a dedicated closeout pass rather than a half-removal.
